full_details: Mistress Ansell had sent for the barber. He shaved the beard close, once, for court, and nobody named a price on her stair. At St John's the chair at the end of the long room was treated as a greater chair. Bryan made them bow to it empty. Sam had bowed four times and was told that once was the drill. The Master left the Nurse as she stood, because Her Majesty was nursed. Of the pretty play he took forty lines of lament over a girl who is not dead, and you were annoyed because the cut was better. The Yeomen lent two cloaks, for the Prince and for Paris, to come back on Innocents' night and be counted. Nick spoke low and held. The Master signed three books for Richmond and said nothing at all of the king. The tables took the hour and the bow. In the afternoon the Rose had Harry the Fifth on a board. You did not go. At two you were Egeon, and the old margin still said not to explain the sea.
one_sentence: Yaxley shaved you close for the chair, the Master took forty lines and signed three books, and at two you were Egeon.
title: The beard shaved close, and forty lines taken
